title: See and fix customer details from the field
body: Open a customer straight from a job to call, text or email them, correct a wrong phone number or spelling, update the carrier, policy and claim numbers, and add or remove the other people on the job — an adjuster, a tenant, a property manager. Everything is edited in place, so nothing pulls you out of what you were doing. Adding a new customer now lands on that customer instead of dropping you back at the dashboard.
